notes: Nine modules for five proposals (P100 split into one adapter per platform, cond 1). Providers created: bluesky (public.api.bsky.app, plc.directory; sources appview, plc_audit; trusted, open) and discord (discord.com; source invites; trusted, open); the seeded npm, pypi, codeberg, dev_to, huggingface, docker_hub and gitlab providers are referenced by their existing sources (no extension needed: the core P321 classifier already maps the PyPI Client Challenge, DEV 'Forbidden Bots' 403, Cloudflare challenges and keyless 403s to BLOCKED/challenge). Every provider keeps personal_data_review null (legal step). All modules are PASSIVE third_party, run_on='seeds' except discord_invite (run_on 'any', resolved only for analyst seeds or invites whose parent is an IOC/text/file/channel context, cond 2). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant was requested; self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo/GitLab stay out of scope (backlog). Shared npm/PyPI/Codeberg/Docker Hub parsers live in v3lum/modules/username_social/dev_registries.py for P359 reuse (P100 cond 8); p2-G05-2's org_code_footprint was built in parallel and may switch to them. Discord 429: the core retries once on a Retry-After <= 15 s; a final 429 is RATE_LIMITED with Discord's retry_after. Webhook URLs (P101 cond 5) are never requested: finding tags c2 + phishing_kit_exfil, token kept as type + first4/last4 + SHA-256 (core sanitize.mask_secret). Docker Hub layer secrets go through the core sanitize.find_secrets detectors; passwords and URL credentials keep only their type. Correlation rule p2g051_shared_key_fingerprint (info, PROBABLE) links github_user and gitlab_user accounts that publish the same SSH/OpenPGP fingerprint (P103 cond 3), with 2 positive and 2 negative graph fixtures. Fixtures come from the prep captures (LIVE/RESEARCH minimised, DERIVED/DOC-SHAPED marked in _meta); two real candidate DIDs in the Bluesky search sample were pseudonymised. The golden-path route tests/fixtures/acceptance/domain/bluesky.json was captured live once (searchActors q=example.com) with every candidate handle/DID/name pseudonymised. Vocabulary fragment v3lum/data/vocab/p2-G05-1.json and platform fragment v3lum/data/platforms/p2-G05-1.json (bluesky, npm, pypi, discord) added. Tests: 71 offline batch tests + 4 rule fixtures green; registry contract green for the 9 modules; tests/test_lint.py (P327 tree lint) green; ruff clean; live 9/9 passed (V3LUM_LIVE=1). Full offline suite: only other batches' tests failed (bcb_authorized_institutions x2, typosquat bcb rows, walletexplorer x2 - transient, passed on re-run - and a transient registry-class check that passed on re-run).
